metricDefinitions.newVocabulary: target final row count minus current-main target baseline row count
metricDefinitions.newDictionaryEntries: final dictionary exact keys absent from current-main baseline
metricDefinitions.modifiedExistingEntries: current-main dictionary entries changed in place (must be zero)
metricDefinitions.properNouns: unique proper-noun lemmas referenced in final target range
metricDefinitions.multiWordExpressions: new target vocabulary rows whose lemma contains whitespace
metricDefinitions.stageDirectionEntries: final target rows explicitly marked category=stage
metricDefinitions.polysemousWithInThisPlay: final target rows with inThisPlay whose dictionary entry is contextual/polysemous
